drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 49-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 1.55, creatinine 1.01, hemoglobin 13.1, lactate 1.8-4, platelets 127, sodium 140, wbc 17.2; vitals dbp 51-57, heart_rate 104-117, map 64-72, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 21-25, sbp 90-103, spo2 95-97, temp 38.6-39
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Blood cultures x2; Lactated Ringer's 30 mL/kg IV bolus; Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.98, hemoglobin 13, platelets 135, sodium 140, wbc 14.2; vitals dbp 61-72, heart_rate 86-97, map 77-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 17-20, sbp 108-119, spo2 96-97, temp 37.3-38.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 49-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
